sections.title: Otto J. Krause — WWII B-17 navigator
sections.summary: Otto J. Krause of Detroit served as a navigator with the 91st Bomb Group, 324th Bomb Squadron, Eighth Air Force, based at RAF Bassingbourn. He flew mostly on B-17 Mah Ideel (43-37993 DF-N) with Lt. William Laws’ crew, earned the Air Medal with oak leaf clusters, and finished as a First Lieutenant. He married Geraldine Staub around 1945.
highlights: Unit: 91st Bomb Group / 324th BS / 8th Air Force, RAF Bassingbourn
Aircraft: Mah Ideel B-17G 43-37993 (codes LL-U then DF-N); ~72 missions; returned USA 11 Jun 1945; scrapped Kingman AZ Dec 1945
Laws crew (Otto navigator): mostly Mah Ideel; co-pilot Bernard “Ed” Goldstein KIA 30 Nov 1944 on another crew
Sample Mah Ideel missions (Halpert list): Ludwigshafen, Schweinfurt, Merseburg/Leuna, Cologne, Berlin (3 Feb 1945)
Awards: Air Medal + oak leaf clusters (late 1944 orders)
Wartime photo FRE 5634 by Dale Darling shows Otto with a B-17
Married Geraldine Staub ~1945

sections.title: Lozon brothers — WWI Canadian service
sections.summary: Two of Madeline’s brothers appear in Canadian WWI records from Wallaceburg. Solomon Alex Lozon (sapper #3131895) enlisted Feb 1918 with the 1st Western Ontario Regiment, sailed to England May 1918, and served in France before returning in 1919. Peter Adolphus (Dulphy) Lozon (#3134471), born 29 Aug 1896, enlisted July 1918 and was discharged early 1919.
highlights: Solomon Alex Lozon — Spr., CEF 3131895; overseas England/France 1918–19
Peter Adolphus Lozon — 1st WOR 3134471; enlisted 1918, demobilized 1919

sections.title: Gerald Krause & Karolyn Crosier Krause
sections.summary: Gerald Francis Krause (b. 20 Dec 1953), son of Otto J. Krause and Geraldine Staub, married Karolyn Dolores Crosier (b. 1 May 1959), daughter of Frederick Charles Crosier and Dolores Marie Altz. They have been married at least 40 years (church wedding; exact date/place still open). Their children are Jeremy Francis, Emily Elizabeth, Elizabeth Ann, and Ann Emily Krause. Public death notices for Dolores (2005) and Kathleen (2009) name Karolyn (Gerald) Krause. Family memory: Karolyn worked briefly for Rochester Avon Recreation Authority (RARA), then was a stay-at-home mom; Gerald taught history in Detroit at Greenfield Union Elementary-Middle School (420 W. 7 Mile Rd.), near the 8 Mile area, roughly from the late 1980s through the mid-2010s. That school’s former principal Beverly Campbell was among the educators charged in the 2015–16 DPS Norman Shy kickback scandal. Rochester school years (family memory): Karolyn went to school with Madonna’s sister; Madonna (b. 16 Aug 1958) was a little older and once went on a date with Gerald’s brother Eric. Public context: Madonna Louise Ciccone graduated Rochester Adams High School in 1976; her sister Paula Mae Ciccone (b. 22 Aug 1959) is nearly the same age as Karolyn and also appears in Adams yearbooks—so Paula is the likely classmate match, though the exact Rochester school for Karolyn is not yet confirmed. People-search records place Karolyn D. Krause in Troy, Michigan.
